lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized into approximately 10 visible vertical columns posterior to the gill region. The blobs within these columns are vertically aligned and follow the dorsoventral curvature of the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect the circular blobs, creating a series of anchor nodes that define a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges are visible along the flank, each characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with light-toned upper edges and shadowed ventral margins.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a dense population of small, high-luminance spots concentrated along the proximal leading edge, with spot diameter increasing and density decreasing towards the trailing edge.
